description: The DuckDB releases that duckdb: and ducklake: sources are tested with. Spice loads the DuckDB library installed on the host and needs 1.5.0 or later; each entry is the newest patch release of a supported line. Keep the list in ascending order: the last entry is the release spicescript's duckdb and ducklake sources use by default (--duckdb-version picks another), and CI runs the DuckDB scripts again on every other entry (.github/workflows/e2e_test_ci.yml).
